title: Source parameter extraction
responsibility: Extracts parameter names and normalized type text from source spans while respecting nested brackets and generics.

inputs.name: splitTopLevel.masked
inputs.description: Masked text whose top-level separator positions should be found.

inputs.name: splitTopLevel.separators
inputs.description: String of individual separator characters to recognize at nesting depth zero.

inputs.name: parseParameters.code
inputs.description: Original parameter-list or object-type text containing the type spellings to retain.

inputs.name: parseParameters.masked
inputs.description: Corresponding masked text with identical offsets for delimiter analysis.

inputs.name: parseParameters.options
inputs.description: Owner prefix for field names and optional separator characters, default comma.

outputs.name: splitTopLevel
outputs.description: Indexes of separator characters outside tracked brackets/generics; text itself is not split or changed.

outputs.name: parseParameters
outputs.description: Contract items named owner.parameter with normalized explicit type or unknown when absent. Empty pieces are skipped and unrecognized/destructured names become input.

outputs.name: normalizeType
outputs.description: Whitespace-collapsed type text with trailing comma/semicolon removed, or unknown for empty text.
